title: HELIX Terminology: Purchase Order Status
description: Status of purchase orders in the institutional procurement process.

codes.definition: PO created but not yet submitted for approval. Requester is finalizing specifications, quantities, vendor selection, and budget coding.

PO submitted and routing through institutional approval workflow. Approval levels determined by dollar amount (e.g., department head up to $5K, dean up to $25K, VP up to $100K, president/board above).
PO approved at all required levels. Budget checked and encumbered. Ready to dispatch to vendor.
PO sent to the vendor. Serves as the institution's contractual commitment to purchase. Includes delivery terms, payment terms, and any special conditions.
Some items on the PO have been received and receipted; others are outstanding. Partial payment may be processed via 3-way match (PO, receipt, invoice).
All items/services on the PO have been received and receipted. Ready for final invoice matching and payment processing.
PO fully received and all invoices paid. Any remaining encumbrance is liquidated (released back to available budget). PO is archived.
PO cancelled before completion. Encumbrance reversed. If any payments were made (partial receipt), the cancellation applies only to the unreceived portion. May require vendor notification.
PO modified after dispatch. Changes may include quantity, price, delivery date, or specifications. Requires approval and may re-trigger budget checking if the total increases.
